recommendation.explanation: The fastest route is recommended. No alternative meets both the infrastructure improvement and travel-cost thresholds.
factors: Keep added walking time and distance proportionate
No qualifying coverage gain of at least 10 percentage points within the tradeoff limits

warnings: Eligible mapped infrastructure includes explicit public hiking trails, which may have natural surfaces. Coverage is not a pavement, condition, or accessibility assessment.
Overlapping infrastructure is deduplicated before coverage; 2 duplicate features removed and 73.99m of near-coincident supplemental linework trimmed.
Proximity to a mapped facility does not establish a connected or usable walking path. City points are campus/building locations; provider endpoints may snap to the walking network.
